scope: Finally delivered revision6 append-only creature relations; revisions1-5 snapshots stay byte-identical

abilities.name: Ember Dart
abilities.effect: A narrow ember shot; preserves Homura's current bolt and armor exposure.

abilities.name: Root Circle
abilities.effect: Radial push and one-heart heal with a separate 360-update heal lock; preserves Midori.

abilities.name: Gust Fan
abilities.effect: Directional projectile clearing and wind-up interruption; preserves Fuuri.

abilities.name: Stone Guard
abilities.effect: A 36-update one-hit guard and short-range interrupt; preserves Kohaku.

abilities.name: Hearthline
abilities.effect: Trace three warm floor cells; after a 24-update warning they flare once. No lingering multi-hit stacking.

abilities.name: Canopy Knot
abilities.effect: Root a target in a small patch for 60 updates and shield the hero from one projectile; does not stack with Stone Guard.

abilities.name: Slipstream Loom
abilities.effect: Place a 48-update curved air lane; bends hostile shots sideways, without reflecting damage or changing collision.

abilities.name: Vaultstep
abilities.effect: Plant an arch-shaped shield for 48 updates; hold one additional hit, but forbid attacking during its 12-update root.

abilities.name: Dew Ring
abilities.effect: Lay a small water ring that slows ordinary enemy movement for 60 updates; bosses are not immobilized.

abilities.name: Tide Stitch
abilities.effect: Connect two marked pools for a single dash-back rescue; never crosses unmarked walls or story gates.

abilities.name: Chime Pin
abilities.effect: Send a returning tuning pin that cancels one telegraphed attack; misses have a long recovery.

abilities.name: Threadhold
abilities.effect: A narrow Wood tether deals16 Q4 base damage and pulls one ordinary enemy at most8 swept pixels. Bosses cannot be pulled. Only tagged loads can be reeled in field puzzles.

abilities.name: Shuttle Span
abilities.effect: Set a short visible thread between two authored endpoints for at most60 updates;24 Q4 once per enemy per cast. Every segment and target must have line of sight.

abilities.name: Heat Pocket
abilities.effect: Place one visible stationary heat patch that bursts after18 updates for24 Q4 once per enemy; maximum lifetime48. Field heat charges affect only tagged receptacles.

abilities.name: Firing Drawer
abilities.effect: Move a stored heat patch between two short visible positions before its arrival burst,24 Q4 once per enemy. Maximum lifetime60; never crosses unmarked walls or ignites from phase alone.

abilities.name: Washback
abilities.effect: A short frontal surge deals24 Q4 and pushes ordinary enemies at most10 swept pixels. No boss displacement. Buoy only explicitly tagged dock loads.

abilities.name: Wake Turn
abilities.effect: A telegraphed L-shaped surge travels at most48 pixels across two orthogonal segments,24 Q4 once per enemy. Check walls on every segment and target; pivot only marked floating loads.

abilities.name: Counterdrop
abilities.effect: Place a visible small Earth impact that lands after18 updates for24 Q4 once per enemy. Press only authored counterweight pans; manual weights remain a mandatory-route alternative.

abilities.name: Counterpoise
abilities.effect: One placed weight intercepts one hostile projectile then emits a32 Q4 Earth pulse. Maximum lifetime48; no player invulnerability or healing; normal boss vulnerability still applies.

abilities.name: Quarterturn
abilities.effect: Redirect one approaching hostile projectile90 degrees into a visible side lane, making it friendly Metal without field or fire tags. Align only marked four-position rail junctions.

abilities.name: Gimbal Screen
abilities.effect: Place one directional gate for at most48 updates, turning up to two later hostile shots90 degrees. A per-cast projectile ledger forbids repeated redirection; friendly shots are ignored.

abilities.name: Leafbound
abilities.effect: Brief companion sidestep and narrow lateral Wood cut, 16 Q4 once per target. Swept collision; no player teleport or invulnerability.

abilities.name: Canopy Arc
abilities.effect: Previewed two-segment curved seed arc, 24 Q4 once per enemy. Bounded path and wall collision; not a stronger straight shot.

abilities.name: Ridgekick
abilities.effect: Short widening Earth wedge, 20 Q4 once per enemy, with bounded push of ordinary targets. No boss displacement.

abilities.name: Rampart Turn
abilities.effect: One short angled ridge redirects an ordinary walking enemy into a visible side lane, then crumbles for 20 Q4. No boss displacement or player-trapping collision; one ridge maximum.

abilities.name: Lens Dart
abilities.effect: Narrow Water bead splits into two outward rays only on its first target impact: initial 16 Q4, secondary 8 Q4. Initial target cannot be hit again; rays respect walls.

abilities.name: Prism Wake
abilities.effect: One short-lived visible line splits the next eligible ordinary hostile shot into two harmless outward droplets, then ends. Endpoint Water burst is 24 Q4; one line and one consumed shot, no recycling.

abilities.name: Ember Hush
abilities.effect: One visible warm mark lengthens an ordinary enemy's next attack windup, then pops for 16 Q4 Fire. Boss telegraphs are not retimed; one mark and finite expiry.

abilities.name: Bellows Ring
abilities.effect: Visible expanding Fire annulus with an empty safe center, 24 Q4 once per target at its edge. One bounded ring; respects obstacles.

abilities.name: Sideguard
abilities.effect: Brace a narrow flank for one ordinary melee hit and reply with a 16 Q4 Earth swipe. Front and rear remain exposed; no general invulnerability.

abilities.name: Vault Step
abilities.effect: Move a narrow guard to one of two explicitly selected side positions, producing a 24 Q4 lateral wave after interception. One eligible hit; visible vulnerable sides remain.

abilities.name: Pinch Window
abilities.effect: Catch one marked ordinary melee strike in a narrow frontal arc and reply with a 24 Q4 Metal pin. Clear startup, no instant universal parry; boss windows remain unchanged.

abilities.name: Shear Gate
abilities.effect: Place two visible facing blades for one short crossing window; crossing target receives 24 Q4 once. One gate maximum and bounded lifetime; existing boss vulnerability rules apply.

abilities.name: Sapling Feint
abilities.effect: One brief grounded decoy diverts one eligible ordinary enemy approach, then folds. No boss taunt, player teleport or invulnerability.

abilities.name: Canopy Exchange
abilities.effect: Two short-lived decoys with a visible connecting line redirect one eligible approach toward the safer endpoint. A 16 Q4 Wood snap only after activation; no teleport or invulnerability.

abilities.name: Rill Fork
abilities.effect: Short Y-shaped Water fork, 12 Q4 per branch with one hit cap per target and a small slowing effect. Bounded segments respect walls; no player pull.

abilities.name: Veil Curl
abilities.effect: Clearly drawn Water crescent with a gap catches side approaches for 24 Q4 once. Escape lane remains open, walls block the curl and the player is never pulled.

abilities.name: Warm Echo
abilities.effect: Mark one visible target for the next ordinary weapon hit, triggering one delayed 16 Q4 Fire follow-up. One mark and short expiry prevent stockpiling; no through-wall targeting.

abilities.name: Paired Echo
abilities.effect: Link two separately aimed target marks. Striking one triggers a weak follow-up on the other only with line of sight; total 24 Q4 budget, no chains, friendly fire or through-wall targeting.

abilities.name: Needle Bank
abilities.effect: One Metal spine with one wall ricochet and a visible reflection. Swept segments, 20 Q4 maximum once per target; no extra bounces.

abilities.name: Quill Return
abilities.effect: Three-spine fan retracts along the creature's current unobstructed lane. Outbound and return share a 24 Q4 per-target budget; at most three bounded objects and no through-wall return.

abilities.name: Warm Thread
abilities.effect: Draw a 40px ground thread after an 8-update warning; first crossing ends it. No through-wall segments.

abilities.name: Coil Clamp
abilities.effect: Two hooked arcs close on a 32px pocket; a target is hit once across both arcs. The player can walk through.

abilities.name: Crown Interval
abilities.effect: Show three short spokes, then activate them in order; share a 32Q4 target budget across the whole cast. Gap remains visibly safe.

abilities.name: Heel Knock
abilities.effect: A narrow 22px stomp cone interrupts eligible ordinary foes; no boss displacement or terrain mutation.

abilities.name: Brace Reply
abilities.effect: Visible frontal bracing arc catches one eligible ordinary contact attack, then replies; expiry gives no damage and no invulnerability.

abilities.name: Archfall
abilities.effect: A visible overhead arch lands in a wide 44px frontal crescent after its warning. No temporary solid wall, crush or player push.

abilities.name: Burr Skip
abilities.effect: One bouncing seed follows two 18px ground hops; first ordinary hit gets a short visible slow. Walls end the path.

abilities.name: Root Hem
abilities.effect: Two parallel 32px root lines leave a walkable central gap; crossing either gives one brief ordinary-root effect, never on a boss.

abilities.name: Cone Drop
abilities.effect: Aimed visible 12px landing marker within48px; one falling cone hits after16 updates, with line of sight checked at aim and impact.

abilities.name: Mist Stop
abilities.effect: A short square puff at28px arrests one eligible ordinary rush without pulling the player; one target hit per cast.

abilities.name: Cup Shower
abilities.effect: A stationary narrow three-drop column falls at a visible marker; all drops share24Q4 maximum per target.

abilities.name: Ribbon Sweep
abilities.effect: A45px lateral water band travels along one wall-checked segment; widens only after its first12px. Single target budget24Q4.

abilities.name: Pick Tap
abilities.effect: Two short alternating nail jabs; second occurs only if first misses, so one enemy cannot take both.

abilities.name: Spiral Notch
abilities.effect: A narrow28px corkscrew strike; deals ordinary Metal damage with bounded stagger on an already vulnerable target. No armor bypass.

abilities.name: Tail Pendulum
abilities.effect: A short visible diagonal swing releases one18px lateral shard; swing and shard share24Q4, walls stop both.

abilities.name: Cinder Tilt
abilities.effect: One26px diagonal dart from the chosen facing side, with a readable aiming blink; stops at first wall or enemy.

abilities.name: Plume Cut
abilities.effect: A narrow rising slash then a forward falling slash; shared24Q4 target cap, no auto-tracking after startup.

abilities.name: Ash Screen
abilities.effect: A stationary small screen consumes one ordinary hostile projectile, expires after40 updates, then makes a16Q4 outward puff. Boss beams unaffected.

abilities.name: Gravel Sift
abilities.effect: A short fan of three ground chips, sharing20Q4 per target; maximum travel30px and wall stops per chip.

abilities.name: Terrace Lift
abilities.effect: A sequence of two rising28px wedges separated by a safe lateral gap; one hit per target across both, no forced boss movement.

abilities.name: Sprig March
abilities.effect: One slow ground bud advances36px with a visible toe-like motion; it ends on first enemy or wall rather than lingering.

abilities.name: Trellis Bend
abilities.effect: Two connected ground segments form one chosen L-shaped path, capped48px total; one hit per target and no wall penetration.

abilities.name: Bead Step
abilities.effect: Three small outward beads leave large gaps; one enemy can receive only16Q4 across the fan. No homing.

abilities.name: Dewfold
abilities.effect: An expanding five-lobed ring shows safe gaps before moving; edge-only24Q4 once per target, never a full-screen burst.

abilities.name: Range Echo
abilities.effect: Outbound nondamaging lane36x8; return only damages its marked forward18..30px band. Face the range bracket before R; no tracking after startup.

abilities.name: Bracket Fold
abilities.effect: Two20px diagonal segments sweep inward from lateral +/-14 to a point28px forward; neither is a projectile. Left/right during the first8 updates chooses the folding diagonal; otherwise facing default.

abilities.name: Margin Cycle
abilities.effect: Four8x8 corner cells of a40x24 rectangle activate one at a time in clockwise order; sides and center never damage. First8 updates choose the starting corner with one cardinal direction; all corners are previewed.

abilities.name: Ballast Nudge
abilities.effect: One12x16 shell stroke24px ahead deals16Q4 and pushes an ordinary target6px perpendicular, swept in1px steps. Left/right during first8 updates chooses the push side; player never moves.

abilities.name: Keel Return
abilities.effect: A20x20 open keel outline catches one entering ordinary foe; after8 updates nudges it at most8px back toward its recorded entry edge. Place with facing; entry edge is recorded once and visibly highlighted.

abilities.name: Crown Teeter
abilities.effect: Two14x12 lobes24px ahead exchange raised/lowered states twice; only the downward lobe damages; central8px corridor stays empty. Choose initial lower side during first8 updates; second fall is automatic.

abilities.name: Crook Reach
abilities.effect: A3px-wide U path goes forward20, sideways12, back8; swept tip stops on the first wall. Left/right in first8 updates chooses hook side; total path40px.

abilities.name: Trellis Quarter
abilities.effect: One16px frond pivots through90 degrees around a point20px ahead; inner6px hub is harmless; entire sweep is wall-clipped. Startup selects clockwise/counterclockwise; pivot and swept sector are visible.

abilities.name: Bower Ladder
abilities.effect: Three12x4 bars at forward12/24/36 and alternating lateral offsets-10/+10/-10 activate near-to-far with8-update intervals. Facing rotates the ladder; side selection mirrors the offsets, never length or damage.

abilities.name: Rimcrawl
abilities.effect: A6px rim travels16px then follows the near face of its first wall for at most24px; convex corners stop it; no crossing the wall. Choose tangential left/right in startup; without a wall it ends after16px.

abilities.name: Gate Release
abilities.effect: Two18px parallel lips separated12px register one target entering from the front; only that target leaving the back triggers the24Q4 close. Facing selects entry/exit; backing out safely cancels; no target is trapped.

abilities.name: Stencil Press
abilities.effect: A28x24 stamp24px ahead leaves two6x10 empty windows at offset-8/+7; after18 warning updates its solid stencil hits once. Left/right startup mirrors the unequal windows; all safe holes are previewed.

abilities.name: Warm Script
abilities.effect: One3px trace advances32px along a triangular centerline of lateral amplitude6 and period16; no homing or fork. Facing sets axis; startup side changes initial wave slope.

abilities.name: Halfhalo
abilities.effect: A12px front semicircle then a24px rear semicircle grow in sequence; each retains a90-degree gap; one target budget across both. Startup side chooses gap diagonal; the second gap is opposite.

abilities.name: Wicktrace
abilities.effect: Record four player positions over12 updates, each segment capped12px; after12 warning updates a warm tip retraces up to36px in reverse. Walk to draw the preview during the first12 active-play updates; standing creates only one8px spark.

abilities.name: Palmturn
abilities.effect: Five4x4 arm-tip cells at radius16 rotate exactly72 degrees as one procedural shape; center and connecting arms are harmless. Startup side selects rotation direction; no full orbit or retained shield.

abilities.name: Crossbloom
abilities.effect: Four4px-wide arms extend to horizontal +/-24 and vertical +/-12 around a point16px ahead; central8x8 square remains harmless. Startup up/down swaps the long and short axes; expansion is one bounded shape.

abilities.name: Accordion Run
abilities.effect: A36px ribbon of three12px segments folds at two joints from straight to a mirrored Z;2px tips damage, broad ribbon body is visual only. Startup side chooses Z orientation; both hinge arcs preview before movement.

abilities.name: Coil Meter
abilities.effect: A fixed36px zigzag with two90-degree joints carries two6px pulses in opposite directions; only one pulse is damaging at a time. Startup side mirrors the zigzag; alternating live pulse is bright and solid-outline.

abilities.name: Hinge Bite
abilities.effect: A20px narrow jaw bar pivots90 degrees around a visible joint28px ahead; require player-to-joint and joint-to-hit line of sight. Choose pivot side in first8 updates; jaw point stays fixed after startup.

abilities.name: Loopclasp
abilities.effect: Two unequal loop outlines of radii10 and16 share one8x8 crossing; alternating loops prime the crossing twice; only the crossing damages. Facing aligns the long loop; startup side selects which loop primes first.

abilities.name: Combfront
abilities.effect: One24px transverse comb with four3px damaging teeth and four3px gaps advances24px; all teeth stop together at first scenery contact. Facing sets motion; startup side shifts tooth alignment by3px.

abilities.name: Veil Divide
abilities.effect: A28x28 square24px ahead alternately activates its two triangles; a6px diagonal stripe stays harmless and each target hits once total. Startup left/right chooses diagonal; first triangle is marked with dots, second with stripes.

abilities.name: Triad Nest
abilities.effect: An equilateral-like triangle with vertices(0,24),(-18,-10),(18,-10) about a point24px ahead flashes its interior after20 updates; central6x6 hole stays harmless. Startup up/down inverts the triangle around the same center; no vertex can cross solid scenery.
